summary: Master Circular 2024 consolidates previous guidelines, updates fee limits, and clarifies qualification criteria.
executive_summary: Master Circular 2024 consolidates previous guidelines, updates fee limits, and clarifies qualification criteria.
key_changes: AUA fee cap reinforced at 2.5% per annum.
Qualification requirement updated for principal officers.

changes.heading: Fee Schedule and Limits
changes.previous_text: Advisers may charge fees based on mutual agreement with clients.
changes.current_text: Advisers shall not charge fees exceeding 2.5% of AUA per annum per client family.
changes.summary: Imposed strict 2.5% AUA cap and client family aggregation.
changes.impact: Requires renegotiation of fee schedules exceeding 2.5%.

changes.heading: Cybersecurity and Disaster Recovery
changes.current_text: All registered IAs must conduct annual cybersecurity audits.
changes.summary: Introduced mandatory annual cybersecurity audit framework.

changes.heading: Transitional Provisions 2020
changes.previous_text: Existing IAs have 6 months from October 2020 to align agreement terms.

changes.heading: Short Title and Scope
changes.previous_text: These guidelines shall apply to all entities registered as Investment Advisers with SEBI.
changes.current_text: These guidelines shall apply to all entities registered as Investment Advisers with SEBI.
